newsitem.title: DUBAI: Aramco discovers more crude and gas reserves.
newsitem.headline: Aramco discovers more crude and gas reserves.

text.p: Saudi Aramco has discovered two new crude and gas reserves in the eastern and central provinces of the kingdom, acting Saudi Oil Minister Abdul-Aziz al-Khoweiter said on Saturday.
"The discovery of al-Wefra gas field is the third such discovery in the eastern province which yields very high gas output," the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) quoted al-Khoweiter as saying.
He said gas extraction from al-Wefra field exceeded 40 million cubic feet per day and condensates were at 2,600 barrels per day.

Al-Khoweiter said that Arab Super Light (ASL) from the central province's new al-Khuzama well, 120 km south of Riyadh, flowed at the rate of 1,550 barrels per day and gas extraction totalled one million cubic feet.
The state oil firm markets ASL crude in Asian markets.
